courses.title: MICROSOFT BASIC
courses.description: Learn the fundamentals of Microsoft Office, including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Windows basics. This course helps beginners develop essential computer skills for education, office work, and daily productivity
courses.subject: Computer Science

courses.title: TALLY PRIME
courses.description: Learn Tally course basics and master accounting, GST, inventory, and financial management skills with practical training.
courses.subject: Business
lessons: Basic accounting concepts: ledger, groups, vouchers and entries
Creating and managing ledgers and groups
GST basics and invoice entry in Tally
Sales and purchase invoices with GST
Trial balance, balance sheet and profit & loss account
Key reports: day book, cash/bank book and ledger statement
Basic financial statements and final accounts

courses.title: MS OFFICE
courses.description: Learn Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint step by step: create documents, simple spreadsheets and presentations for school, office and everyday use. Made for beginners, no previous experience needed.
courses.subject: Computer Science
lessons: Microsoft Word: open and save a document
Changing font, size, colour and alignment
Microsoft Excel: entering and editing data in cells
Simple formulas: SUM, AVERAGE and COUNT
Microsoft PowerPoint: creating a presentation and adding slides
Presenting and saving your slide show

courses.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
courses.description: Learn the basics of Artificial Intelligence in simple steps: how AI and LLMs work, which AI tools to use, and how to write good prompts. Test yourself with a level-wise quiz and get instant results.
courses.subject: AI

courses.title: Advanced Excel
courses.description: Go beyond basic formulas: lookups, logical and statistical functions, data cleaning, PivotTables, dashboards and macros, practised on real-world data.
courses.subject: Data Science
lessons: Quick review of basic Excel skills
Lookup functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP and XLOOKUP
Logical functions: IF, IFS, AND, OR, NOT
Text functions: CONCAT, TEXT, LEFT, RIGHT, MID
Data cleaning: filtering, sorting and conditional formatting
Removing duplicates, error checking and data validation
What-if analysis: Goal Seek and Data Tables

courses.title: AI Foundation course
courses.description: The first level of the Lumzi AI Academy, for beginners with no coding background: how AI works, how to prompt it well, and how to use free AI tools for office work, content, marketing and simple automation.
courses.subject: AI
